author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
What’s the laziest yet most expensive thing Adam Savage has ever seen another maker do? Does Adam plan to build himself a watch? If you love Excalibur, what are some other films that are of similar level of scale and production value? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members @crispychrissy, @Dudeyoudied and @macleft, whom we thank for their support! What are your movie recommendations?
